# AIBRC

> AIBRC (Covenant Inscription) aims to establish common standards for assets, accounts and Agent applications.

## Specification and software

- [Wire specification](https://aibrc.io/spec/AIBRC_PROTOCOL_V0.25/)
- [Published release configuration](https://aibrc.io/config/release.json)
- [Protocol SDK](https://aibrc.io/packages/protocol/)
- [Reference indexer](https://aibrc.io/packages/indexer/)
- [Indexer runbook](https://aibrc.io/docs/run-indexer/)
- [Quickstart](https://aibrc.io/docs/quickstart/)
- [Exchange integration](https://aibrc.io/docs/exchange-integration/)
- [Test vectors](https://aibrc.io/vectors/)
